install_tell: docker run -p 8082:8082 confluentinc/cp-kafka-rest:latest — no auth by default
misconfig_patterns: GET /topics unauthenticated returns full topic catalog

response_markers: bare JSON array of topic names
active_probe.false_positive_check: Content-Type header must be vnd.kafka.v2+json — vendor-unique, no collision

deployment_tells: HTTP bridge in front of a Kafka cluster — often exposed when the binary 9092 port is firewalled but this REST bridge is not
pivot_paths: GET consumer endpoints -> read payloads without binary client tooling
